SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTBALANCE_SEC] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
AS(
	SELECT
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,BSP.ID) ID
	,BSP.REFDATE
	,BSP.ENDSHARES
	,BSPD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BSP.INSERT_DTTM
	,BSP.BNK_CODE
	FROM BUSC.SEC_PORTFOLIO_DELTA BSPD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_PORTFOLIO BSP ON BSP.ID = BSPD.ID AND BSP.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_SRC
AS(
	SELECT
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		ID,
		REFDATE,
		ENDSHARES

	)) HASHROW, ID, RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_TGT
AS(
	SELECT
	HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
		CustomerAccountId
		,[Timestamp]
		,BalanceAmount

	)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
	FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA
AS(
	SELECT
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ID, TGT.CustomerAccountId) as CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_SRC SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_TGT TGT
	ON SRC.ID = TGT.CustomerAccountId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.ID
,[BalanceTypeId] = 'Securities Portfolio'
,[Timestamp] = SRC.REFDATE
,[BalanceAmount] = SRC.ENDSHARES
,[IsoCurrencyCode] = 'PHP'
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'SEC'
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BNK_CODE
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = SRC.Insert_dttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance SRC ON SRC.ID = TGT.CustomerAccountId;


--INSERT REORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[BalanceTypeId]
,[Timestamp]
,[BalanceAmount]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,[FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID]
,[WORKFLOWID]
,[TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]
)

SELECT
ID AS [CustomerAccountId]
,'Securities Portfolio' AS [BalanceTypeId]
,REFDATE AS [Timestamp]
,ENDSHARES AS [BalanceAmount]
,'PHP' AS [IsoCurrencyCode]
,'SEC' AS [SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,BNK_CODE AS [FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID]
,0 AS [WORKFLOWID]
,0 AS [TASKRUNID]
,INSERT_DTTM AS [INSERTDTTM]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA;

END
GO
